title: P2: investigate two reproducible SENATRAN mock E2E contract mismatches
body: Published DEVAI 2.6.2 native E2E at 8cf4223a completed with 1853 passed and 2 failed: national-extensions.e2e.spec.ts CDT recognition expects 200 and receives 402; renach-workflow.e2e.spec.ts exam idempotency expects 201 and receives 402. A separate full replay at diagnostic commit 90dc922b resets the existing mock seed before every test file and reproduces both mismatches, so cross-file contamination is not a sufficient explanation. Product sources, assertions and timeouts are unchanged. Evidence: work/rounds/R-0036/reports/remediation-8cf4223a/evidence-manifest.json. Owner: Inspector to capture the actual error envelope and compare the seeded business state; Engineer/Architect to remediate the established fixture or product cause in a separate PR. Preserve original failed readings and no weakening of assertions. Do not call either failure an enablement regression without source-history evidence.
